ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image depicts the general course of the main stream of the Yangtze River, with the river extending from west to east, and cities along the Yangtze River such as Panzhihua, Chongqing, Wuhan, Nanjing, and Shanghai marked along the line, indicating that the “Yangtze River water” in the question refers to the water resources of the Yangtze River basin. The question stem asks “The South-to-North Water Diversion Project will make people in which regions drink Yangtze River water?” Among this, “South-to-North Water Diversion” means transferring the relatively abundant water resources of the south, especially the Yangtze River basin, to water-scarce areas in the north. The northern water-receiving areas are mainly the Northwest and North China regions, so the answer is the Northwest and North China regions.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中长江干流及沿江城市，确认题目所说“长江水”指长江流域水资源；再读取题干中的“南水北调工程”“哪些地区的人们喝上长江水”；根据“南水北调”含义——把南方长江水调往北方缺水地区——判断受益地区为西北和华北地区。
